stem: A propagation batch performs far below its historical range after an undocumented protocol change. What should the specialist do?
choices: Edit the historical records to match.
Discard the poor result from the dataset.
Document the deviation, preserve the batch evidence, compare against the prior method and escalate rather than silently changing the record.
Assume the seed lot alone caused the problem.
rationale: Document the deviation, preserve the batch evidence, compare against the prior method and escalate rather than silently changing the record.
